name: HYTEK | POTATO RUNTZ | HAND ROLLED JOINT | 1.5g
description:
The candies just keep coming in strong!!!! The Potato Runtz gives off that sweet candy flavor. 

No this is not a Potato Kush cross. This is the cut named after the artist Imran Potato. Slide on your caveman slippers and get ready for the ride!

Category: Hybrid
Cross: Zkittles x Gelato
Cut: Imran Potato
Type: Hand Rolled Doink w/ Spiral Glass Tip (1.5g)
